judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a `.lore/dod.md` file and a single failing acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversation-list.acceptance.test.ts`), without implementing any production code. None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, docs, or specs were made. Because the implementation is completely missing, the newly added acceptance tests will fail immediately against the unmodified codebase.
